entries.f8eafcb2f41904b0: A single segment, the DMP Business. Using its proprietary data management platform "IM-DMP," which collects audience data (information such as Web site visit history), it supports client companies' marketing and DX (digital transformation). The consolidated subsidiary Credit Score Co., Ltd. develops data solutions for the financial industry. Revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥3,363 million. Revenue by service is not disclosed separately.
